source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Jupiter

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

skipped.reason: Jupiter-Rahu favourable results are truncated in the scan.

rules.text: Jupiter-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle or trine, or exalted or in its own sign — pre-eminence among peers, the deep goodwill of authority, wealth, vehicles, clothes and ornaments, a new and well-built house, a rise in fortune, efforts bearing fruit, gains from the employer and benefits for spouse and children.
Jupiter-Jupiter: with Jupiter debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th — poor company, grievance, disputes with co-heirs, unwise conflicts, distress to spouse and children, and loss of wealth.

Jupiter-Saturn: with Saturn in its own, exalted or a friend's sign, or in an angle, trine or the 11th — high position, great happiness, clothes, ornaments and wealth, marriage, vehicles, land and property, warmth from children and friends, and travel to the west.

variants.text: Saturn is also well placed from Jupiter: comfort through wealth, children and livestock, with gains through working people.

rules.text: Jupiter-Saturn: with Saturn in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign — loss of wealth, mental strain, risk of injury, trouble for spouse and children, unhappy events at home, difficulty with staff and conflict among siblings.

variants.text: With malefics joining Saturn there: confrontation with siblings and friends and obstruction in business.

rules.text: Jupiter-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle or trine, dignified, or with the 10th lord — profit through government, great comfort, ambitious plans carried through with official support, and vehicles, clothes and livestock.

variants.text: Mercury in an angle or trine from Jupiter, or exalted: money earned in one's own country, warmth from both parents, and vehicles through a friendly patron.
Mercury is aspected by Mars: more opponents and loss of happiness and business.

rules.text: Jupiter-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter or with malefics, and without benefic aspect — loss of wealth, journeys to foreign countries with risk of theft or injury on the way, and aimless wandering abroad.
Jupiter-Mercury: Mercury with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th — sudden quarrels without cause, provocative speech, trading losses and conflict with opponents.

variants.text: A benefic also joins or aspects Mercury: affection from the spouse and an inflow of money; comforts and gains at the start, with some loss and physical strain at the end.

rules.text: Jupiter-Ketu: with Ketu joined by benefics — moderate comfort and gains, but a plain diet and some dependence on others for provisions.
Jupiter-Ketu: Ketu with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter — loss of money through official action, restriction, loss of strength, and strong opposition from father and siblings.

Jupiter-Ketu: Ketu in the 4th, 5th, 9th or 10th from Jupiter — vehicles and clothes, ambitions fulfilled with official support, gains of money, heavy profits in business, livestock, and gains from foreigners.

Jupiter-Venus: Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th or in its own sign, with benefic support — a fine vehicle and clothes, large gains through official favour, abundant luxury, profit from a journey east, auspiciousness at home and many good works.

variants.text: Venus is also in an angle, the 2nd or the 9th from Jupiter: money and provisions, a meeting with authority, a vehicle, the birth of a child, music, the company of scholars, fine food and support for siblings.

rules.text: Jupiter-Sun: with the Sun exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle, trine, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th — gains of money, official recognition, splendour, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments, the birth of children, friendships, and success in every venture with the employer's help.

Jupiter-Sun: the Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the ascendant or from Jupiter — low mood, indifference to good works, ill feeling towards others, worry over siblings and needless quarrels; health needs care.

Jupiter-Moon: a strong Moon in an angle or trine, or exalted or in its own sign, and well placed from Jupiter — official honours, splendour, warmth from spouse and children, fine food, good works, high reputation, more children and grandchildren, and comforts and money through official favour.

Jupiter-Moon: a weak Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter — loss of standing, money and acquaintances, foreign visits, trouble from authority or theft, disputes with partners, and worry over the mother and maternal relatives.
Jupiter-Mars: with Mars in an angle or trine, or exalted or in its own sign — a wedding, acquisition of land, popular support and success in every pursuit.

variants.text: Mars is also well placed from Jupiter with benefic influence: wealth and assets, fine food, profit from official goodwill, comfort from spouse and children, and pilgrimage.

rules.text: Jupiter-Mars: Mars in the 6th, 8th or 12th or debilitated, under malefic influence — loss of money, crops or housing and health needing care; the first half is hard and the second half very happy.

Jupiter-Rahu: Rahu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Jupiter — risk of theft and injury, confrontation with authority, anxiety from pressure of work at home, opposition from siblings and co-heirs, bad dreams and needless quarrels.
